title: 3_5_The_Snow_Ball

question_options.question: How would you rate this episode?
What do you think of Nate and Zoe going to the dance together?
Are you excited for the next episode?

nodes.text: Ben starts pumping his legs furiously, sprinting across the parking lot!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Dude! When did you become this fast?
Ben reaches the back of the bus as it pulls out onto the street! Owen is a few steps back!
The door squeaks open, and Coach sticks his head out!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Oh! So you `do` want to play?
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh! So you [color=#e23b3b][i]do[/i][/color] want to play?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yes, Coach!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Very much, Coach!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Hurry up, then! Prove it!
The bus accelerates a little bit more. Ben and Owen dig deep, running as fast as they can!
A second later, Ben catches up with the door and hops in! He reaches back and pulls Owen in.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Phew!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Nice of you to join us, ladies!
The bus arrives at the Willow Glen gym.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: All right! We'll see on the court whether that actually focused you up or not.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Here's your dumb phone back, Kale!
Spencer moves back to his seat.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That was weird.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Big time. I've never been bullied into a quiz before.
He has failed.

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ha! Heck yeah!
Spencer stands and calls out to the whole team!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I couldn't hear you! What are we going to do tonight?
The whole team yells!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Win!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Win![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Win!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Win![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's what I'm talking about!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Lose?! Did you just say 'lose'?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Win! I meant win!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You better have!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What? Tie! You want us to tie!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, that would make both teams happy, right? It's all about having fun.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Are you crazy?! It's about winning, Kale! Winning!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh, that seems more like the attitude you would expect from me.
Ben doesn't say anything!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Why are you quiet?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I thought it was a trick question!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No! We're going to win, stupid!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh, yeah, I should have said that.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Last question... What are we going to do tonight?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Wrong! If you get fouled making a three-pointer, you can make the free throw for a four-point play.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh... Right.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Where's your head?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Wrong! If you get fouled making a three-pointer, you can make the free throw for a four-point play.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh... Right.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Where's your head?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If you get fouled making a three-pointer, you get one free throw and the chance for a four-point play.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's what I like to hear, Kale!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What's the most amount of points you can score in one play, including free throws?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's right! I tried to trick you. Nothing's more important than family!
Spencer punches Ben in the arm!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Family is forever! Nothing is more important than family!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Emily's pretty import--
Spencer punches Ben again!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Nothing!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Nothing![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Spencer punches Ben in the arm!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Family is forever! Nothing is more important than family!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And don't be such a suck up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What's most important?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Family, girls, or basketball?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Are you messing with me? This is serious!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yup!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Are you messing with me? This is serious!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What about when you pick up your dribble and then dribble again?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Are you an idiot?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Then focus up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Are you an idiot?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Then focus up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Good! That one was easy!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What's it called when you run with the ball without dribbling?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: There it is!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Weak!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Weak!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: How many points is a free throw worth?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Wrong!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Good!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Wrong!
After a few more pictures, the girls take a group shot. They crowd around Emily's phone to see how it came out.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hot!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm jealous of me, and I'm in the picture!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: We look `so` good! I'm sending this to Ben right now!
nodes.text_bbcode: We look [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] good! I'm sending this to Ben right now!

nodes.text: Emily cues up a message and sends the pic off to Ben.
You are now playing as Ben...
Meanwhile, on the bus to Willow Glen...
Ben's phone vibrates. He checks the message from Emily and finds the picture of the girls!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whoa! Owen, check it out!
Ben shows the picture to Owen.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: They look like hot college girls!
Ben rests his head against the window.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Why did $ZOE have to schedule the dance for today?
From the seat behind them, Nick taps Owen's shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What are you guys looking at?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's a picture Emily sent of her, $ZOE, Kimi, and Sam dressed up for the dance.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Interesting... Let me see!
Nick reaches for the phone, but Owen playfully holds it away from him.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You just want to see Sam, don't you?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: No! I'm a photographer! I just want to see what kind of lighting Emily used!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sure you do.
Owen hands him the phone.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh, wow. That desk lamp makes for a good rim light. Oh, and Sam looks, uh, nice, I guess.
Spencer hops into the seat next to Nick and snatches the phone away! He looks at the picture!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Nice?! She looks nice how a celebrity supermodel looks nice! Samface looks a thousand percent smoking `hot!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Nice?! She looks nice how a celebrity supermodel looks nice! Samface looks a thousand percent smoking [color=#e23b3b][i]hot![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Spencer stashes the phone in his pocket.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh, that's my phone, Spence.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Correction. `Was` your phone. For the rest of this bus ride, this phone is mine. I'm taking it hostage!
nodes.text_bbcode: Correction. [color=#e23b3b][i]Was[/i][/color] your phone. For the rest of this bus ride, this phone is mine. I'm taking it hostage!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Seriously, though, I need it to text with my girlfriend.
Spencer adopts his nerdy, nasally accent.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ooh, I have to send my girlfriend a sideways smiley face! I'm brb in the afk so lol!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Have you ever texted anyone?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Shut up, both of you! Ben, you're completely whipped, and Owen, you're dumb! Neither of you are focused--

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: `Is` focused. Neither is singular.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Is[/i][/color] focused. Neither is singular.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey, Granny Glasses, either shut up or take a picture. This conversation is for basketball players only.
Nick very casually raises his camera and takes a picture of Spencer's angry face.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Anyway, neither of you `is` focused on what matters... The game!
nodes.text_bbcode: Anyway, neither of you [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] focused on what matters... The game!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Willow Glen is one of the best teams in the state! They've got some Swedish freshman who's already being scouted by colleges!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: If we don't win this one, we'll `have` to win the next one in order to make it to Sectionals!
nodes.text_bbcode: If we don't win this one, we'll [color=#e23b3b][i]have[/i][/color] to win the next one in order to make it to Sectionals!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: So for the rest of this trip, we're going to get you focused.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: How are you planning on doing that?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Easy!
Spencer gets into Ben and Owen's faces!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm going to ask you questions until all your puny mind can think about is basketball.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Now how many points is a layup worth?
$ZOE thinks about the moment when Howard broke up with her at the Halloween Dance...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard... Are we... Are we ever going to see each other again?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Not for a while. But maybe someday.
Then he leans down and kisses her tenderly. She savors the moment as if it's their last kiss in the world...
She feels a tinge of sadness.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Like this?
Emily snaps the picture.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: That was good... Kind of.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Huh. I tried to think about when Howard left me... But I wasn't that sad! Is something wrong with me?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Relax, cuz. You probably aren't that sad about it because it was the second time you two broke up.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That makes sense.
$ZOE closes her eyes and imagines what it would be like if Owen kissed Paige...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You're everything I've ever wanted, Paige. Way better than that Mary-Sue, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: She can't even come to `one` of my basketball games.
nodes.text_bbcode: She can't even come to [color=#e23b3b][i]one[/i][/color] of my basketball games.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Blah blah blah I'm rich! Now I'll say something mean that makes you like me! Now kiss me!
Owen leans down and tenderly kisses Paige!
$ZOE opens her eyes...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Like this, Emily?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Wow! You really turned on the emotion! I'm starting to tear up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Great! Now I am too!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Me three!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Everyone stop crying! We don't want to smear our makeup!
The girls laugh at themselves as they dab at their eyes.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Am I that jealous of Paige?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: How jealous do you think the guys are going to be when they see how hot we look?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: There's only one way to find out!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Picture time!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Make sure you get my good side!
The girls take turns having their picture taken. When it's $ZOE's turn, Emily's taking the pictures.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Okay, give me happy, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Like this?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Perfect. Let me see a silly face. Like someone just threw water on you!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Gasp! I've been doused!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I like it! Now how about a sad one? Something to say, 'I'm so sad you're not here.'
$ZOE tries to make a sad face.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Like this?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Sadder!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Like this?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: No! Sadder!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is as sad as I can get right now, I'm having so much fun!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Don't even bother. When $ZOE's happy like this, it's impossible to bring her down.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait, I can do this! I just have to think of something really sad!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Like Howard going away?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Or somebody you like dating another girl?!
$ZOE tries to concentrate on something really sad... On...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Fabulous? Why'd you say fabulous? Is something wrong with my makeup?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, it looks great!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But you didn't say great! You said fabulous!
Sam beelines her way back into the bathroom and slams the door!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's wrong with fabulous?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Maybe she thought you said something else, like... 'Fatulous?'

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That's not it! Don't you know anything? Sam said that your dress looked fabulous first.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: So, it looks like you chose the first word that came to mind rather than the negative one you actually thought.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What? That's not what happened!
$ZOE knocks on the bathroom door!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Go away!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam, I didn't mean anything by it! You look like a knockout!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Really! Get out here!
Sam steps out of the bathroom.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sorry. I don't know why I freaked out like that.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It happens. I should have been paying more attention anyway.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks! We all look sensational in our own way, don't we?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You can say that again!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks! We all look sensational in our own way, don't we?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You can say that again!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks! We all look sensational in our own way, don't we?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You can say that again!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What about you almost punching Keith? Was that also to protect me?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: No, no... `That` was just a stupid mistake from a guy who was acting like a complete idiot.
nodes.text_bbcode: No, no... [color=#e23b3b][i]That[/i][/color] was just a stupid mistake from a guy who was acting like a complete idiot.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Don't go too easy on yourself.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Seriously, I'm really sorry about what happened with Keith. I just got jealous.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: But ignoring that, we did have a pretty good time.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah... We did.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So, I should probably get going. Was there something else you wanted to talk to me about?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Yes...
Nate takes another big breath.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I want to take you to the winter dance.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wow. Two seconds ago you were trying to get out of the doghouse. Now you're asking me to the dance?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Fortune favors the bold?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't think so. Your time's up.
$ZOE gets into her car and shuts the door. Nate raps on the window with his knuckles, and $ZOE rolls it down.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Just listen... Please? When I met you, you were in a rough place because Howard left you.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Now, once again you're hurt, and Howard's gone.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I don't really have the same feelings for you...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You mean not the same feelings you have for Owen?
$ZOE slowly nods, surprised.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I get it. The heart wants what the heart wants. But you know who's going to be there for Owen today at his basketball game? `Paige.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I get it. The heart wants what the heart wants. But you know who's going to be there for Owen today at his basketball game? [color=#e23b3b][i]Paige.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: She's gone to all of his games... I even heard she gave him his basketball shoes.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Yup. Doesn't it seem like they're already together?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I've heard something to that effect...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: So why waste your time on a guy who's not into you? Especially since the girl he `is` into is your rival?
nodes.text_bbcode: So why waste your time on a guy who's not into you? Especially since the girl he [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] into is your rival?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Is that the kind of guy you want? Or do you want a guy like me, who's always been there for you? Always thinking about you?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Even if sometimes I show it in the wrong ways...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I'm not going to hurt you, $ZOE, I promise. And isn't that what you want?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll... I'll think about it.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Sure, I'll get my nicest outfit ready, just in case its good news. You know, $ZOE, nothing would make me happier.
$ZOE blushes.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Bye, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Bye...
Nate walks away, leaving $ZOE stunned.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ohmygosh, what am I gonna do?!
Later, the girls are getting their nails done at the salon...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Don't do it, $ZOE. `Don't` go to the dance with Nate.
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't do it, $ZOE. [color=#3b78e2][i]Don't[/i][/color] go to the dance with Nate.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why not?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Would 'I don't like him' be satisfactory enough?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I might need a reason or two.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How about three? He's not in the same league as Howard, he's overprotective in a way that worries me, and...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And I don't like him.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't think 'I don't like him' qualifies as a reason for why you don't like him.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, it should.
$ZOE turns to Emily and Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What do you two think?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I like his hair. I'm out of the whole guy-ranking business, but if I were to give him a score, it would be pretty high.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I haven't really spent enough time with him to say anything that isn't superficial.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: So superficially, he's cute!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Believe me, with him it's all surface.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Let's stop talking about Nate... Emily, how are you and Ben doing?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Ugh. Don't even get me started.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is him playing basketball that big a deal?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Basketball's fine! It would be completely hypocritical of me to get on Ben's case for playing basketball when I'm swimming all the time!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Emphasis on 'all the time.'

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: The problem is my dad! Ever since Ben joined the team, my dad thinks he's the best thing since sliced turkey!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Don't you... Want him to get along with your dad?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Of course! I want them to be able to be in the same room together, but I don't want them to be bff's!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, that sounds bad.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What's annoying is I've `told` Ben that he doesn't have to impress my dad so much, but he still does it!
nodes.text_bbcode: What's annoying is I've [color=#3b78e2][i]told[/i][/color] Ben that he doesn't have to impress my dad so much, but he still does it!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I think there's something else going on... But I'm not sure what it is.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Is it just me or is this too sad for a Girls' Night conversation?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, we're definitely going to have to step it up! We can still make this fun!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I promised Emily and Kimi I'd take them to dinner. Let's do that now and then we'll come back to Emily's place to get ready!
After dinner, back in Emily's room, the girls are trying on dresses, doing their hair, and putting on makeup!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Emily, you look `so` amazing!
nodes.text_bbcode: Emily, you look [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] amazing!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Are you serious? I `wish` I had your hair!
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you serious? I [color=#3b78e2][i]wish[/i][/color] I had your hair!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Sam, you're like a goddess in that dress!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I try, I try. $ZOE, where did you even find your dress! You look totally fabulous!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks! I got it on sale! But what about your makeup, Sam? You look...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What was going on between me and Howard was between `us!` You shouldn't have done that, Nate!
nodes.text_bbcode: What was going on between me and Howard was between [color=#3b78e2][i]us![/i][/color] You shouldn't have done that, Nate!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Maybe I shouldn't have... But you two needed to break up, didn't you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: So all I did was speed along what was going to happen eventually. Delaying it would have hurt more, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's true...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I care for you, $ZOE. You can see that, can't you?
$ZOE nods.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: So you admit that sometimes it's good for others to take part in your life.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Um, well...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Think about it. All I did was speed along what was going to happen eventually. I helped you from getting hurt more down the road!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's not--

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: It's the same reason I lied about the folder. For you, $ZOE!
Ben tries to run as fast as he can, but he trips over his own feet!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whoop!
He sprawls on the pavement!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Come on, Ben!
Owen races ahead, catching up to the bus!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'll be there!
Ben scrambles back to his feet!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hurry up, Ben!
Ben tries to take a shortcut through the parking lot! He leaps over the hood of a car...
But his foot catches and he falls in a heap on the concrete below.
Suddenly, he's at the game!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: How did I get here?
Around him his teammates are all different!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Hey Ben, pass it to me. If you don't, you'll never be a real man!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Don't you love me, Ben? I'm right here, I'm wide open. Pass me the ball!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: I'm sorry I haven't been in your life much, Ben. But I don't like you hanging around Emily's father.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You mean Emily, right?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Why would I care if you spend time with Emily? She's great!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait... Why can't I spend time with Coach Kessler?!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: He's not me, Ben. He'll never be me.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Ben! Hurry up! Or we'll break up!
Ben tries to throw the ball to Emily, but it melts in his hands.
He starts running toward her to try and get her the ball but with every step on the court, she gets farther and farther away!
Ben isn't sure what any of it means, but by the time he regains consciousness, he'll be sure of one thing.
You are now playing as $ZOE...
As Owen and Ben hop on the bus in the distance, $ZOE, Emily, and Sam look at each other.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We've got a dance in a couple of hours, and none of us have dates...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Kimi and I are going to start our Girls' Night at the salon! You two should join us!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm in!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Me too!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We'll go get our nails done at this place near Emily's house. Emily, you can ride with me.
The girls laugh excitedly as they head toward their cars.
As $ZOE is about to reach hers, Nate comes running up!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: $ZOE! Wait up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, I have to go. I'm meeting up with the girls right now.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Oh yeah? Then I'll only ask for a minute of your time instead of the five I was hoping for.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How considerate. I don't really want to talk to you, okay?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Look, I know I messed up with you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Messed up? You almost punched Keith at Homecoming, you lied about what was in that manila folder with the bobcat on it, and you were the last one to talk to Howard before he broke up with me!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think you've done more than just mess up!
$ZOE opens her car door, and Nate steps aside.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Don't you think I deserve a chance to defend myself?
$ZOE stops herself from getting into her car. She turns to him.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Make it quick.
Nate takes a big, deep breath.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Yeah, I... I lied about what the folder was. I knew that Owen was covering up how he'd put that kid in the hospital. I didn't trust him.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I figured someone who runs from his problems wasn't someone you should be trusting either!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: All he wanted was a clean slate!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Well, maybe that's what I'm hoping for now...
This catches $ZOE off-guard.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: And as for Howard, all I told him was what he needed to hear. That he was holding you back... That he couldn't be there for you...

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Whoever thought it was funny to screech like bagpipes in a washing machine, don't ever do that again!
Coach yells at the guys from inside the bus!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Hurry up, Romeos! We're running out of daylight, and we've got a tip-off to make!
You are now playing as Ben...
Nearby, Ben and Emily are interrupted by Coach's yelling!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: And another thing!
$ZOE steps back from Owen.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Excuse me, guys. I just wanted to do a dance for you to, um, inspire you tonight.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Awesome! Let's see it!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I love a good inspirational dance! That's what makes the chicken dance so popular!
The team's attention is now fully on $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Here we go!
$ZOE starts wiggling her hips and pumping her arms out in front of her furiously.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Woo! Go, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And then I'll give you a little bit of this!
$ZOE starts sidestepping, her arms at right angles like a scarecrow.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Classic!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And follow it up with this!
She crosses her arms in front of her at the wrist and pumps her feet, like a dizzy cowboy.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Love it! Saw that on an internet clip the other day!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And... Done!
The guys all hoot and holler as $ZOE, out of breath, returns to Owen.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't know if that counts as an embarrassment.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What? I totally acted like a fool in front of everyone!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, but you're actually good at dancing, so you kind of pulled it off!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't know if it counts as an embarrassment if you get applause when you're done.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Partial credit?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, fine. You're officially a third of the way toward atonement...
$ZOE clears her throat.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Really? You're actually going to sing, huh?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You said that's the only way to make it count.
$ZOE clears her throat one more time...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: { I hope that you guys win the gaaaaaame! {

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: What is that noise?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: { If you lost that would be super laaaaaame! {

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Is that coming from the bus?!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I think it's coming from $ZOE! Shut up, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: { But you wouldn't be the one to blaaaaame! {

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It feels like my teeth are disintegrating!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: { So have no shame, have no shaaaaaaame! {
$ZOE blushes and tries to hide behind her hair as the players express their disgust.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, that was impressive and terrifying all at the same time.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Told you it was bad.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Congratulations, you're a third of the way toward atonement!
The girls reach the bus.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm going to hang back for now. I'm not ready to talk to Nick.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sure.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: It's something you should do only when you're ready.
Emily goes to talk to Ben. $ZOE walks up to Owen as he loads his bag on.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, Owen.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE... What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just wanted to wish you 'good luck' before your game.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And I... I also wanted to tell you how sorry I am that I can't make it and, you know, how sorry I am about the dance being today. I feel really bad!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Don't worry about the dance. You were under a lot of pressure.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But... I should worry about something else?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You promised you'd come to a game, and you haven't.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I can't just let you off the hook that easy!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So... Well... Uh... Now I don't know what to do! I'm not used to someone rejecting my apology.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You're just going to have to make it up to me. I think you should start with `an embarrassment.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You're just going to have to make it up to me. I think you should start with [color=#e23b3b][i]an embarrassment.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... What?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: My grandma always says a broken promise can be mended with an embarrassment, a gift, and a confession.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Since we're out here in public, this would be a great time for an embarrassment.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're serious?
Owen tries to form as serious a face as possible.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Fine. What do I have to do?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I am `so` glad you asked. I think since tonight's the dance you should definitely do a silly dance or sing a silly song!
nodes.text_bbcode: I am [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] glad you asked. I think since tonight's the dance you should definitely do a silly dance or sing a silly song!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Right now? In front of the basketball team?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Right now!
$ZOE takes a deep breath.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think I'll definitely pick dance. I'm such a horrible singer! Like, when I sing, cats die.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It can't be that bad. You didn't seem fazed the other day when you rapped.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Rapping and singing are completely different! Trust me, it's `that` bad.
nodes.text_bbcode: Rapping and singing are completely different! Trust me, it's [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] bad.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Okay. Okay. But you should know... The more embarrassing the act, the easier it is to mend the promise. It's up to you...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What's there to talk about? He cheated on me, I threw hot chocolate at him, he apologized. I think that counts as a win in the breakup handbook!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Wait... Did you ever talk to him after the car accident?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: A little. We've talked a couple of times at parties. About photography and football, of all things.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I meant, `about` Sara.
nodes.text_bbcode: I meant, [color=#3b78e2][i]about[/i][/color] Sara.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No... You think I should?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: At the very least it might make both of you feel better.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It'll be good for you, Sam!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And that's it? You don't have any ulterior motive?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! I swear!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Because guys and girls can't really `be` friends! It always gets romantic!
nodes.text_bbcode: Because guys and girls can't really [color=#3b78e2][i]be[/i][/color] friends! It always gets romantic!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So you can see how this seems like a setup!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't think that's true!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Setting people up means putting them together and saying, 'Sam, this is Nick. She thinks you're cute. Nick, this is Sam...'

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: 'He wants to have a bunch of little Nicklets with you!'

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Emily!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Sorry, I couldn't resist!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ew! I just pictured a bunch of babies wearing Nick's hipster glasses.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's definitely `not` where I was going...
nodes.text_bbcode: That's definitely [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] where I was going...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Back me up, Emily?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Sorry, it sounds like you're trying to fix your cousin up.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sigh. Fine. Don't believe me.

nodes.prompt: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

nodes.text: Sam sighs.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So, what made you decide to call him now?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Because of what Emily said about her and Ben. They're too busy to spend any time together. She has a great guy, but he's not around.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So if I have a chance to be with a great guy who's `actually` going to be around, don't I owe it to myself to give him a chance?
nodes.text_bbcode: So if I have a chance to be with a great guy who's [color=#3b78e2][i]actually[/i][/color] going to be around, don't I owe it to myself to give him a chance?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I `guess` I see your point.
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]guess[/i][/color] I see your point.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And for what it's worth, I'm `not` going to just fall for Nate. I'm not an idiot.
nodes.text_bbcode: And for what it's worth, I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] going to just fall for Nate. I'm not an idiot.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know. Fine. Call him. But if he harms one hair on your perky head, I will get very medieval on him.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You mean, like throw him a fancy tea party?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What? No! It means I'm going to--

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm kidding, Sam. Just wanted to see how naive you thought I was...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You got me. I'm going to go help Emily with her hair.
Sam heads back to the room. $ZOE takes a deep breath and calls Nate...
That night, Nate meets $ZOE, Sam, Emily, and Kimi just outside the dance.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE. A rose for a rose.
He hands her a single red rose.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Awww...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: That's really sweet of you, Nate.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: All the good ones are taken!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh brother.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: $ZOE mentioned that you guys are going stag to the dance, so if it's not too forward...
Nate hands Emily, Kimi, and Sam their own roses as well.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Too nice!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Thanks, Nate!
$ZOE nudges Sam with her elbow.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: See?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, I'll give credit where it's due. That was smooth.
As they get closer to the dance, Nate holds $ZOE back.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Girls, if you don't mind, I'd like a word with $ZOE alone?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Sure. We'll be inside.
Sam looks at $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Medieval.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Medieval.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: The girls step inside.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's up?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: We're about to go to the dance together.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It does seem that way, yes.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: The last time we went to a dance, we went as friends.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's true.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I'm not going to this one as a friend, $ZOE.
$ZOE blushes.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... I know.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Good.
Nate holds out his arm for $ZOE, and the two of them walk together into the dance.
What will happen to the girls at the dance? Find out in next week's episode of Surviving High School!
You have reached the end of `Season 3, Episode 5: Snow Ball, Part 1!`

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Honestly, Sam, if I hold every guy to Howard's level I'm just going to end up becoming an old cat lady!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Do you even think the Howard I grew to love could compare with the Howard I first met?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And that's not confusing.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The point is that if Howard can't even compete with Howard, it isn't fair to try to compare other guys to him!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay, I guess that's true.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm glad you agree.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But what about how overprotective Nate is? I mean, he almost punched Keith at Homecoming!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know, and that's not excusable, but he `does` feel really bad about that...
nodes.text_bbcode: I know, and that's not excusable, but he [color=#3b78e2][i]does[/i][/color] feel really bad about that...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Let's give him a medal then.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So when he almost punched Keith at Homecoming just because Keith was talking to you... That was okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, of course not!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Then how isn't that a valid argument?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Because yeah, he overreacted, but that was `one` time! He felt really bad about it, apologized, and hasn't done anything like that since.
nodes.text_bbcode: Because yeah, he overreacted, but that was [color=#3b78e2][i]one[/i][/color] time! He felt really bad about it, apologized, and hasn't done anything like that since.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That you know of! Howard would never have done something like that!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, Nate's not Howard! Howard also lied to me about why he was back!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What are you saying? You'd rather be with Nate than Howard?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No... No. I'm just saying that Howard wasn't perfect either.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I just wish Ben and I didn't have such busy schedules. I never realized how good I had it back when Ben could hang out with me whenever I wanted.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Being with a great guy is wonderful... But being with a great guy and both of you having time to spend together... `That` is the dream.
nodes.text_bbcode: Being with a great guy is wonderful... But being with a great guy and both of you having time to spend together... [color=#3b78e2][i]That[/i][/color] is the dream.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I think I'll settle for no guy and doing whatever I want!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: She's joking, right? Whatever guy I end up with, I hope he's not a loser!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There is something to be said for a guy who's around... A guy who's there for you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Um... I'll be right back. I need to make a phone call.
In the dining room, $ZOE is trying to find Nate's number in her Contacts list when Sam comes out, her arms crossed.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Are you calling Nate?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why did you ask for my opinion about him if it doesn't mean anything?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Your opinion means a lot to me, Sam!
$ZOE finds Nate's name, but she doesn't press the call button.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I get that you don't like him, but I don't think you have valid enough reasons to convince me.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So... Him not being in Howard's league... Or being way overprotective...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Which one of those isn't valid?

nodes.prompt: Which reason of Sam's isn't valid?

options.label: Nate not being in Howard's league.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Which reason of Sam's isn't valid?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What did you just say?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I think she said 'Ben looks so Paige'?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Are you saying Ben looks like a girl?
Emily looks at the picture again.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I guess in the right light...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, that's not what I meant. Just...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're so lucky to have someone like Ben.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You have a funny way of saying it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry... I was distracted!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Anyway...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Yeah, who knew, right? All this time I thought he was just a really smart guy who liked to goof around.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's like discovering that your boyfriend is actually a superhero.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well... A lesser superhero... Jumpshot Man?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're really lucky to have someone like Ben.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I guess I am.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is something wrong?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Uh what?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What Paige!
Owen follows. He jumps up for his layup and releases the ball early, sending it high into the air, completely over the backboard!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What are you doing?!
It's Ben's turn next! He dribbles twice and tries to grab the ball...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Emily...
But he's completely distracted! He fumbles the ball and it flies off his leg and into the snack shack!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whoops!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You guys have no focus! Worse, you're ruining my post-game nacho-bration!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You'd better figure out what's wrong quick!
Later, the team is warming up before the start of the game...
Ben hands his phone to Nick.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Do you think you could take some pics for me?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh, sure.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Lay up drill! Let's go!
Spencer goes first, easily laying the ball into the hoop.
Ben does more layups on his own, while Owen heads over to talk to Paige for a second.
Nick keeps snapping pictures...
You are now playing as $ZOE...
As the girls move to the accessorizing phase of their Girls' Night, Emily's phone buzzes!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: It's a picture from Ben!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Aww, he looks so cute in his basketball uniform!
Emily shows the picture to Sam and Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ooh! He looks like a movie star in a sports movie!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He's not my boyfriend, but I'll say it. For a skinny guy, he's got nice legs!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Should I be jealous?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I want to see!
Emily shows $ZOE the picture.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Awww! He looks so--

$ZOE stomach drops when she sees what's going on in the background of the picture... Paige is there in the front row of the bleachers, leaning forward, her arms wrapped around Owen, giving him a huge hug!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I, uh, I should probably get going. Coach has a short fuse.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Of course. I hate this, Ben. I want to be there to support you. But I've got a swim meet early tomorrow morning, and your game is so far away.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I have to go home as soon as the dance ends.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I know. Look, it's a total longshot, but if the game happens to end really early, I'll do everything I can to get back here...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Long before you turn back into a pumpkin!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I think you've got your fairy tales mixed up, but I appreciate the sentiment. Beat 'em quick, okay?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Of course! I'll win for you and your dad!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Or just me...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Right. Just you.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And hey, even if we can't be there for each other, we can still make the night fun.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: How?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'll send you pictures of my night from my phone, and you can send me pictures of the dance from yours!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It'll be like you're at the game, and I'm at the dance!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I like it.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Yeah.
Emily steps closer to Ben and kisses him!
The bus's engine roars to life! Coach sticks his head out the door!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Kale! Harris! If you don't want come to this game, that's fine by me! We'll play with four guys if we have to!
The bus's gears shake, and the bus starts pulling away from the curb!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh oh! Gotta go!
Ben turns toward the bus, but Owen runs right into him. The two fall over in a heap!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Get up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: He's not going to leave us, is he?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Who knows?! Coach is crazy, man!
As the bus pulls out of the parking lot, Ben and Owen scramble to their feet!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Do you or don't you want to play today?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Come on! Run!
You are now playing as $ZOE...
As Owen and Ben hop on the bus in the distance, $ZOE, Emily, and Sam look at each other.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We've got a dance in a couple of hours, and none of us have dates...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Kimi and I are going to start our Girls' Night at the salon! You two should join us!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm in!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Me too!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We'll go get our nails done at this place near Emily's house. Emily, you can ride with me.
The girls laugh excitedly as they head toward their cars.
As $ZOE is about to reach hers, Nate comes running up!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: $ZOE! Wait up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, I have to go. I'm meeting up with the girls right now.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Oh yeah? Then I'll only ask for a minute of your time instead of the five I was hoping for.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How considerate. I don't really want to talk to you, okay?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Look, I know I messed up with you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Messed up? You almost punched Keith at Homecoming, you lied about what was in that manila folder with the bobcat on it, and you were the last one to talk to Howard before he broke up with me!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think you've done more than just mess up!
$ZOE opens her car door, and Nate steps aside.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Don't you think I deserve a chance to defend myself?
$ZOE stops herself from getting into her car. She turns to him.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Make it quick.
Nate takes a big, deep breath.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Yeah, I... I lied about what the folder was. I knew that Owen was covering up how he'd put that kid in the hospital. I didn't trust him.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I figured someone who runs from his problems wasn't someone you should be trusting either!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: All he wanted was a clean slate!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Well, maybe that's what I'm hoping for now...
This catches $ZOE off-guard.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: And as for Howard, all I told him was what he needed to hear. That he was holding you back... That he couldn't be there for you...
The bus's engine roars to life! Coach sticks his head out the door!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Kale! Harris! If you don't want come to this game, that's fine by me! We'll play with four guys if we have to!
The bus's gears shake, and the bus starts pulling away from the curb!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh oh! Gotta go!
Ben turns toward the bus, but Owen runs right into him. The two fall over in a heap!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Get up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: He's not going to leave us, is he?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Who knows?! Coach is crazy, man!
As the bus pulls out of the parking lot, Ben and Owen scramble to their feet!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Do you or don't you want to play today?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Come on! Run!
Later, the team is warming up before the start of the game...
Ben hands his phone to Nick.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Do you think you could take some pics for me?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh, sure.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Lay up drill! Let's go!
Spencer goes first, easily laying the ball into the hoop.

You are now playing as Ben...
Far away in the Willow Glen gym, the whistle blows, and the game begins!
Right away, an opposing player gets the tip off, blows by Ben, and scores with an easy basket!
Hahaha! Ben Kale, right? I'm going to be in your face all day, Ben Kale!
You think you can stop me? I'm a perpetual motion machine. I can't be stopped!
Did this guy just use science to trash talk me? Is he... Like me? A nerd-athlete?
Ben catches a pass from Jacob at the top of the key, takes a shot, but has it swatted out of the air!
Oh no! That ball got blocked like an artery filled with cholesterol!
Going back the other way, the guy tormenting Ben pulls up for a three pointer... And sinks it!
I'm going to score so many points tonight! Watching our score is going to be like watching Fibonacci's sequence!
We'll see about that!
Ben passes the ball to Spencer and cuts to the hoop!
Spencer passes it back to him, Ben takes one dribble and--
The same guy steals the ball from him!
Whoop! What goes up, must come down! What comes down, must be mine!
All right. I officially hate this guy.
Kale! Stop turning the ball over!
Ben whispers under his breath.
Great idea.
On the next play, Ben gets the ball in the corner and manages to take a shot, but it bounces off the rim.
I thought you were supposed to be good!
What? No witty quip related to science? Ran out of facts?
You're so bad, you're like a conclusion without data!
You couldn't make a basket even if I gave you the formula for a perfect shot!
Oh, and your girlfriend's super ugly! Just a fact!
Grr!
Ben shoves the guy backward! Immediately the ref blows the whistle and gives Ben a technical foul!
Kale! You're coming out! Ericson get in there!
Hot dog! I'm in! This is going to really liven up my blog!
Ben spends the rest of the first half on the bench...
What is Coach Kessler going to think of me now...
When the buzzer sounds, the Willow Glen crowd chants 'Lars! Lars! Lars!'
The guy shoots Ben a wink as their team saunters off the court.
Ben looks at the scoreboard... It reads 32 - 15 in favor of Willow Glen.
Ouch.
Does this mean Twin Branches is going to lose?
Find out in the next episode of Surviving High School! And that's your bonus scene!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: No more weird dancing near the bus! It's distracting!

nodes.title: The Snow Ball, Part 1
nodes.subtitle: Will $ZOE bring a date to the winter dance?

nodes.text: You are now playing as $ZOE...
It's the second Saturday in December, the day of the winter dance and also the day of the basketball team's big away game!
$ZOE, Sam, and Emily are headed toward the basketball team's bus to see the team off!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks for coming, Sam!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I `was` looking forward to a zombie movie before the dance tonight...
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]was[/i][/color] looking forward to a zombie movie before the dance tonight...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I still don't understand why you needed me to tag along so bad.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Because zombies can wait! They're slow-moving, and the team needs as much support as it can get!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh-huh, support. Because this has nothing to do with how guilty you're feeling after scheduling the dance on the same day as the game?
$ZOE's eyes dart across to Emily.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Um...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: It's okay, $ZOE. I know you had a hard choice to make. Scheduling the dance today upset the fewest people.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm surprised you're not going to the game to support Owen. Wasn't that the plan?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Um... Something came up between us. I'd... I'd rather not talk about it if that's okay.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Fine by me. I still don't understand how having `one` extra person around to support the team is going to mean anything.
nodes.text_bbcode: Fine by me. I still don't understand how having [color=#3b78e2][i]one[/i][/color] extra person around to support the team is going to mean anything.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Especially if that person's me. I don't really do `cheery` anymore.
nodes.text_bbcode: Especially if that person's me. I don't really do [color=#3b78e2][i]cheery[/i][/color] anymore.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, maybe I didn't ask you to come `just` for support.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, maybe I didn't ask you to come [color=#3b78e2][i]just[/i][/color] for support.

nodes.text: $ZOE nods at the bus. Nick is there, loading camera equipment on. Sam stops in her tracks.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nope!
She immediately turns around, but $ZOE stops her!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam, wait! It's not what you think!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Really? Because it looks like you're trying to set me up with my ex-boyfriend, who cheated on me with Sara--
Sam stops talking.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm... I'm sorry, Emily.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: It's okay. I know that you, Nick, and Sara had some history. To be honest, I think you two would be really cute together!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh. Couldn't you at least `pretend` to be more upset?! I really don't want Perky Gumdrops here meddling with my life.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ugh. Couldn't you at least [color=#3b78e2][i]pretend[/i][/color] to be more upset?! I really don't want Perky Gumdrops here meddling with my life.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Sorry, Sam! Can't help you there!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Besides, I'm not trying to set you up! I just think you two...

pov_note: Multi-POV episode. `pov` on a segment is the playable character in control on entry; a node's `set_pov` switches the current POV mid-stream (these are the game's 'You are now playing as X' cards). A dialogue node's `side` is 'left' when the speaker is the current POV (the game shows the current main on the left) and 'right' otherwise. POV is propagated in execution order from `entry`; only main_characters can hold it.
